# LoanInsurance.co.nz

> New Zealand's specialist loan protection insurance comparison and referral service. Connect with authorised NZ financial advisers who compare policies from leading NZ insurers to protect your loan repayments.

## About

LoanInsurance.co.nz helps New Zealanders find the right loan protection insurance. We connect borrowers with authorised financial advisers who can compare policies from multiple insurers including AIA, Partners Life, Fidelity Life, Asteron Life, and Chubb Life. We cover all major NZ cities and loan types. We are not a regulated financial advice provider — the advisers we refer to are licensed under the Financial Markets Conduct Act.

## NZ Market Context (2026)

- OCR: 2.25% (RBNZ)
- Unemployment: ~5.5% nationally
- KiwiSaver hardship withdrawals up 12.6% YOY
- ACC covers accidents only — illness, redundancy, and most mental health conditions excluded
- NZIIS (80% salary, 7 months) proposed but not yet law
- First Home Grant discontinued May 2024; Kāinga Ora First Home Loan still active

## Insurance Types (12 categories)

- Personal Loan Insurance: Protection for personal loan repayments if unable to work
- Home Loan Insurance: Mortgage protection for illness, injury, or redundancy
- Car Finance Insurance: Vehicle loan protection and GAP cover
- GAP Insurance: Covers shortfall between vehicle value and outstanding loan
- Redundancy Cover: Involuntary job loss protection for loan repayments
- Business Loan Insurance: Protects business loan repayments from income disruption
- Mortgage Protection Insurance: Covers your specific monthly mortgage repayment
- Income Protection: Replaces up to 75% of salary for illness and injury
- Payment Protection: Bundled cover for loans — illness, injury, and redundancy
- Critical Illness Cover: Lump-sum payment on diagnosis of serious conditions
- Total Disability Cover: Long-term disability income protection
- Business Interruption: Covers business income loss during forced closure

## Legal

loaninsurance.co.nz is operated by Cover4You. It is a referral and comparison website, not a regulated financial advice provider. The advisers referred to hold FMA licences and provide advice independently. Contact email for all enquiries: hello@cover4you.co.nz
